mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,subject_key AS subjectKey,idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey,request_hash AS requestHash,token_id AS tokenId,token_hash AS tokenHash, token_expires_at AS tokenExpiresAt,replay_until AS replayUntil,response_cipher AS responseCipher,encryption_key_id AS encryptionKeyId FROM mk_referral_invite_replay WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND subject_key=#{subject} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_invite_replay(tenant_id,subject_key,idempotency_key,request_hash,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{subject},#{key},#{hash},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE row_version=row_version
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,participant_id AS participantId,campaign_id AS campaignId,organization_id AS organizationId,shop_id AS shopId, definition_id AS definitionId,definition_version AS definitionVersion,generation,artifact_id AS artifactId,policy_hash AS policyHash, route_epoch AS routeEpoch,state,created_at AS createdAt FROM mk_referral_participant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT subject_key AS subjectKey,subject_key_version AS keyVersion FROM mk_referral_participant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND participant_id=#{participantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_invite_replay SET token_id=#{r.tokenId},token_hash=#{r.tokenHash},token_expires_at=#{tokenExpiresAt},replay_until=#{replayUntil}, response_cipher=#{r.responseCipher},encryption_key_id=#{r.encryptionKeyId},updated_at=#{now},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{r.tenantId} AND subject_key=#{r.subjectKey} AND idempotency_key=#{r.idempotencyKey} AND request_hash=#{r.requestHash} AND token_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_audit(tenant_id,audit_id,actor_id,action,resource_ref,reason,trace_id,occurred_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{r.tenantId},#{auditId},#{actorId},'INVITE_TOKEN_ISSUED',#{r.tokenId},'按原固定规则发行邀请令牌',#{traceId},#{now},#{now},#{now})
mapper.select: SELECT token_id AS tokenId,participant_id AS participantId,token_hash AS tokenHash,expires_at AS expiresAt,revoked_at AS revokedAt FROM mk_referral_invite_token WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND token_hash=#{tokenHash}
